Dear Madam
I have put it in [Mrs Matthew](../persons.html#1689)’s hands, whether to put in the article, or an apology.

The number of [Mothers in Council](../others.html#82) being all arranged, it is very inconvenient, as some contributor must be put off

yours truly

C M Yonge
